name: Alpaca Connection Manager
description: Agent-ready project card for the Alpaca Connectors repository. This project supports the repository's strict Alpaca asset-registration workflow, holdings-category orchestration from ETF constituents, and Alpaca stock-bar planning and update workflows through the documented CLI and reusable modules.

skills.name: Asset Registration
skills.description: Plan or execute the repository's strict asset-registration workflow through `alpaca-connectors asset register`, including exact Alpaca symbol registration and ETF-seed expansion through a supported component provider, with OpenFIGI resolution required before assets are written.
examples: Register NVDA and AAPL through the supported asset registration flow.

skills.name: Holdings Category
skills.description: Plan or execute holdings-backed asset-category sync through `alpaca-connectors holdings-category create`, building categories such as `HOLDINGS__IVV` from ETF constituents only when the extracted holdings resolve cleanly and are already registered.
examples: Create or refresh HOLDINGS__IVV after confirming all extracted holdings are registered.

skills.name: Stock Bars
skills.description: Plan or execute Alpaca stock-bar workflows through `alpaca-connectors asset <ticker> update_prices <period>` or `alpaca-connectors bars run`, covering one registered asset, an explicit ticker list, or a holdings category while reusing the project's `AlpacaStockBarsNode` modules and plan-only flow.
examples: Plan a daily IVV stock-bar update without running the node.
